name: @rello-platform/lead-entity
description: Pure-function classifier + normalizer for Rello Lead entity-shape (LLC, partnership, trust, corporation, individual), PLUS the shared inter-app createLead CONTACT-shape contract (/contracts subpath — the regression-lock SOT for the contact-less-lead acceptance behavior) AND the shape-based contact-field normalizer (/normalize subpath — Self-Healing Import Validation Layer 2; routes swapped email/phone values to the field their shape belongs to under the W-01 two-sided safety rule). Consumed by Harvest-Home (BYOL/intake/merge writers), Rello (createLead validation + write-time fill + CSV import self-heal), and the Phase 7 backfill script. Single source of truth for entity-name normalization across the platform.
